title: Shorter Than I Anticipated
text: Shorter Than I Anticipated. My daughter lives in an apartment at college. She took her bedroom furniture with her leaving behind a mostly empty room at home. I ordered this for that empty room. Though she lives elsewhere, she still comes home for holidays and occasional weekends. We've set this up to hold some of her basics such as underwear, socks, and tee shirts. When she comes home, she rarely brings much in the way of clothing with her because she still has a lot here. We just needed to organize it better. Assembly was okay. It could have been easier. I think the issues my husband had with it was (A) the print on the instructions was really small and difficult to read and (B) it was vague at times. It probably took him about 45 minutes to put it together by himself. It ended up being much shorter than I anticipated. It's about the size of a night stand. It's sturdy enough. It's not what we would call quality furniture, but it's fine for what we need. It would be well suited to someone just starting out.
